pr_title: Don't allow new transformations for reverse arrow after it's hit
pr_body:
Fixes #8618

Before, reverse arrow would quickly scale up while drawable repeat was also scaling up. This looked weird when drawable repeat's scaling synced up with reverse arrow's scaling, almost like as if wrong easing was used (one that ramps up quickly like ``InExpo`` instead of ``Out``). 

This PR ~~removes pending transformations on the arrow when the repeat is hit and~~ doesn't allow new transformations for the arrow to be applied.

issue_context.title: DrawableSliderRepeat and ReverseArrowPiece easings shouldn't be additive
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
Depending on where in the beat a reverse arrow is hit, it's easing will look super wrong (sorta like waves that constructively interfere, both DrawableSliderRepeat and ReverseArrowPiece's easings will be added together)

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
Was unable to capture this. Easy to look on [Mata Ashita's insane difficulty](https://osu.ppy.sh/beatmapsets/172055#osu/443272) as the first repeating slider happens few seconds in and the beat syncs with when you would hit it.
